sources.note: Inserts optimizable latent states at an intermediate Transformer layer rather than at the output, so self-attention makes every continuation token's log-probability differentiable with respect to every latent and reward-weighted gradients reach them from the whole continuation instead of only through their own decoded token.
sources.title: GradCuit: Credit-Assigned Gradient Flow Enables Robust and Interpretable Test-Time Latent Reasoning

sources.note: Shows by two four-armed bandits with nearly identical approximation error, one of which converges and one of which does not, that approximation error cannot characterize whether softmax policy gradient reaches the optimum, and replaces it with a condition on whether the features preserve the ordering of the rewards.
sources.title: Rethinking the Global Convergence of Softmax Policy Gradient with Linear Function Approximation

sources.note: Proves that entropy-regularized policy gradient converges to the regularized optimum at an exponential rate for log-linear softmax policies over continuous state and action spaces, by using the KL regularizer as a Lyapunov function to keep the Fisher information matrix from degenerating.
sources.title: Global linear convergence of entropy-regularized softmax policy gradient beyond tabular MDPs

sources.note: Proves that an entropy bonus permanently moves the stationary point of RL training while covariance-targeted control reaches the unregularized optimum once its coefficient is annealed, and that the bonus shrinks the stability margin where the targeted methods leave it intact.
sources.title: A Comparative Theoretical Analysis of Entropy Control Methods in Reinforcement Learning for Reasoning Language Models

result.definition: Optimising a policy by ascending the gradient of expected return, the family every training method in this archive belongs to. Across 4 sources the corpus's contribution is theoretical: convergence results for entropy-regularised softmax policy gradient beyond tabular settings and under linear function approximation, and a comparative analysis of the entropy-control methods used in practice. Two things those results supply that the empirical literature does not. They make explicit which conditions the practical variants violate -- one source's feature conditions are shown to be real restrictions by an explicit finite-element counterexample where a divergence converges to a constant and radial unboundedness fails. And they give a mechanism for the entropy behaviour everyone measures: differentiating the objective with respect to a token's logit shows positive advantage raising sampled-token probability and lowering unsampled ones, which concentrates mass, with clipping modulating the relative contribution of the two signs.
